# Logistics 0.2.1-main.2

- Mobile Workspaces has a Transfers panel with native progress, completed activity, and interrupted downloads.
- Mobile File Browser has more readable tiles and simpler item actions. Saved documents are available under Libraries.
- AirPlay can retry at the last confirmed position after wake, with a fix for the HEVC segment error that blocked the reported Apple TV retry.
- Select several files with the leading circles, then Move or Archive them together. On iOS, hold over a folder to open it during a drag.
- iOS video puts chapter skips beside the timeline, and notebook cutouts wait for the PDF background before copying.
